name: ANSI/IEEE off-delay timer relay symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for off-delay timer relay, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The off-delay timer form identifies timing after a documented initiating condition is removed. The selected device's supply requirements and timing sequence determine whether the delay can complete during control-power interruption.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace trigger removal separately from auxiliary supply loss.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Off-delay timing is not an automatic statement of how every contact behaves after complete loss of power.
